reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_stores,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_type = 'flagship' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagship_stores,
       SUM(CASE WHEN close_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_stores
FROM stores
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_stores, COUNT(CASE WHEN store_type = 'flagship' THEN 1 END) AS flagship_stores, COUNT(*) - COUNT(close_date) AS open_stores FROM stores GROUP BY country_code
SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_stores, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE store_type = 'flagship') AS flagship_stores, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL) AS open_stores FROM stores GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_stores, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE store_type = 'flagship') AS flagship_stores, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL) AS open_stores FROM stores GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Reads closer to plain English, but FILTER is not available in every SQL dialect.
